column1: # Hebrew (he) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_he` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1) | two (2) | other (0, 3+).
# Written in logical order, as Hebrew is typed. The language is registered with `rtl: true`, so
# the catalog is put in display order when it loads (`bidi::visual_rtl`): egui lays every label
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of the English labels in common Hebrew desktop style
# (commands are verbal nouns: "שמירה", "פתיחה…"; instructions address the user in the plural
# imperative); not taken from Adobe Acrobat's Hebrew localisation or any other product's
# translation. Terminology: comments are "הערות", pages are "עמודים", form fields are "שדות טופס",
# stamps are "חותמות". Product and format names (PdfCraft, PDF, Word, HTML…) stay in Latin
# letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept. Covers the menus, Preferences and
# Fill & Sign so far; other labels show in English.
